label: Will: the HAS_WILL_1 capacity versus a willed two-way giving
resolution: WILL_CAPACITY_VERSUS_WILLED_GIVING_1 is HAS_WILL_1 (DEF 7c64b499-6dba-5e03-bdf3-5acea95d8836), having will as a capacity, the sense of STMT-GOD-HAS-WILL. WILL_CAPACITY_VERSUS_WILLED_GIVING_2 (DEF de24ce2e-84e4-48d8-9cac-5f66ad532015) is exercise-level: a giving by a power classified Rational that is withheld at an accessible world with the same set-up (WilledTwoWayAt, the will-versus-chance batch). Sense 2 implies sense 1 through the OPEN bridge 65e0179f-55d4-4b77-98ba-4b5b26f2d404 ('Whatever has a rational power HAS_WILL_1'). Sense 1 yields sense 2 only with 71fc097b-4039-4812-a498-2ad70fe08b98 ('Whatever HAS_WILL_1 has a rational power') together with one power, giving as exercise and a same-set-up withholding (arguments A and B). Possessing a power classified Rational is unbridged to the possessed appetitive power of 941efd70's second sense (AppetitePowerExercise.Capacity.Possessed). Sense 2 is unbridged to the Wills relation of statement a94c5dfc-c722-49fe-a242-dd39409b079d and to the exercise senses of disambiguation 941efd70-d56f-53f9-b5f9-8acd36711a54. No argument passes between the senses without one of those listed bridges.
